base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y -qq git curl wget unzip apt-transport-https
setup_runtime_commands:
cat > /root/.gradle/gradle.properties << EOF
org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx2048m -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8
org.gradle.parallel=true
org.gradle.caching=true
android.useAndroidX=true
android.enableJetifier=true
EOF
activation_command: export JAVA_HOME=/opt/benchmark/temurin-17 && export GRADLE_HOME=/opt/benchmark/gradle-8.7 && export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk && export PATH=$JAVA_HOME/bin:$GRADLE_HOME/bin:$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:$PATH

prepare_commands: Install Android SDK platform-tools, platforms;android-34, build-tools;34.0.0
runtime_profile.test_only_install_strategy: none - build verification via APK assembly
runtime_profile.notes: Gradle 8.7 is pre-installed. Android SDK requires command-line tools for headless CI builds. sdkmanager may require network access.

notes: Base image ubuntu:22.04 provides a stable foundation. git and curl are explicitly included in system_packages. JDK 17 (Temurin) and Gradle 8.7 are pre-installed. Android SDK is needed for Android extension builds. No special activation is needed beyond setting environment variables (activation_type: system). Note: sdkmanager network access may be constrained in some environments.
